to: each player and each observer separately. The payload holds only the entities in the vision box of that receiver

confirm.note: `"all"` frames are built by `send_all_xy`; `"xy"` frames are a raw JSON string (`RawFrame`) with the same keys, from entries that `monster_to_client` / `player_to_client(p, 1)` built

senders.what: The tick of the instance: `send_xy_updates` sends an `"xy"` frame to each player and observer when something in view changed
`send_xy_updates`: a `"all"` frame when the socket drains after a skipped tick
The `loaded` handler: a `"all"` frame for the new observer
A cave pause freezes the instance: an `"xy"` frame with every actor
